title: Deep Learning Identifies Abnormal Promyelocytes in Peripheral Blood Based on Morphological Analysis.
summary: U-Net segmentation followed by EfficientDet cell recognition detected abnormal promyelocytes in peripheral-blood-smear data; an independent 150-patient PBS set was compared with pathologist consensus. Reported cell-level performance is bounded to the study workflow and is not a standalone APL diagnosis.
